chapters.title: An actual incident in the live twin
chapters.caption: Actual RTX frames. The coaster closure, source data and operator actions are synthetic.

chapters.title: Start with the current incident
chapters.caption: Prepare the selected asset. No forecast or saved comparison is required.

chapters.title: Review the frozen observations
chapters.caption: Status, inspection and open orders retain their source quality and timestamps at proposal creation.

chapters.title: Execute a separate, explicit request
chapters.caption: A synthetic work order is acknowledged and read back. Dispatch does not repair or reopen the ride.

chapters.title: The ride remains closed
chapters.caption: The live asset still reports closed, with one open work order. Acceptance is not physical completion.

chapters.title: Compare an authored design
chapters.caption: Baseline access is unreachable. The separate dining design gives a 40.852 m route at assumed walking speed.

chapters.title: Inspect the native before and after
chapters.caption: Matched static native closeups show the added connection. These images are not the live camera.

chapters.title: Close the connection in the query
chapters.caption: Closing the authored connection removes the route. The query does not change the park or its scene.

chapters.title: Test the unresolved entrance barrier
chapters.caption: The step-free filter still finds no route from the entrance. Authored labels are not certification.

chapters.title: Keep the evidence and the limits
chapters.caption: Export the exact queries, responses and identities. This design query is independent of the forecast.

unencoded_tail.policy: Clip only the unavailable tail to the measured container bound; no tail padding, freeze frame, speed change or first-frame offset inference.
unencoded_tail.first_encoded_frame_alignment: approximate; no offset correction has been inferred

footage_policy: Normal-speed original 1920x960 browser footage, no resize or in-viewport overlays; 120px editorial band below UI; no intro/outro.
timing_basis: Trim uses capture monotonic timestamps relative to page creation; first encoded-frame alignment remains approximate. Container durations are measured independently by FFmpeg.
caption_boundary_policy: First caption covers the ready-content start (within0.5s of its logged start); later captions use logged boundaries relative to trim. No chapter footage is individually cut or repeated.
